title: Record separate c=5 weight-2-family and all-ones-window centre counterexamples
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## Change and mathematical scope

Two separate counterexamples. Not a depth-two exclusion and not a κ change. In the unchanged unsigned dirty connector:

1. **No individual all-ones window forces a legal centre.** Every one of the 4095 admissible all-ones windows has a length-30 floor word with that window and an illegal `S(16) = q_16 + q_17`. 1731 of them also have a word with a legal centre. None forces a legal centre. Of the 2364 windows that force an illegal centre, 1573 do so because `q_16` cannot contain a coordinate 0 (human classes 845 + 721 + 7). The other 791 admit a zero, but no feasible vector is a legal centre; that comparison is an exhaustive census.
2. **The fifteen weight-2 masks admit both polarities.** The sorted floor word realizes all fifteen with illegal `S(16)`. The word `001211112322203343354444555500` realizes all fifteen with legal `S(16)`. Neither word realizes the weight-6 mask.

These two statements do not imply a statement about their conjunction. No conclusion is established about a floor word that realizes all fifteen weight-2 masks and the weight-6 mask together, including in the case where such a word exists. This package does not show that the conjunction forces a legal centre, and it does not show that the conjunction admits an illegal centre.

The weight identity is rechecked and is not that conjunction claim: no allowed 6-tuple of sum 33 has weight 2 or 6, so one pair with `s + t = 33` cannot carry a weight-2 mask or the weight-6 mask.

Merged PR #6216 asserts that no floor word realizes all sixteen masks. This package does not replay that certificate and does not use the asserted empty fibre as a centre conclusion. Open PR #7038 still needs a legal centre that a word actually reaches before the centre-freeze can empty hypothesis (H). This note does not supply that derivation.

The selected conditional κ stays `781451/250000000`. No selected-frontier file changes.

Evidence class: exhaustive finite census. The completeness argument is in the package README. This is not a SAT proof and not a heuristic search. The census counts are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`. This draft uses `cursor/upstream-main-17469fff-b813` as its base because that branch is exactly that commit. The fork's `main` is an older snapshot, so it is not the review base.

Task card: `connector-alphabet-change` (priority revision 8). Scope status: **changed**. The card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the alphabet fixed and records two separate counterexamples toward open question 1 of PR #7038. It does not decide whether the sixteen masks together determine the sum-33 centre. A new operation is not the missing step.

Package: `research/c5-mask-centre-nondetermination`.

Overlap: `scripts/find_overlap.py --offline` at the base commit searched the local note inventory (10180 records, complete head inventory). It hits `research/connector-six-source-small-char`, which is the solver exclusion this note does not rerun. A GitHub search of open PRs hits PR #7038, whose centre-freeze theorem is the predecessor and is not re-proved. The adjacent-centre question, the c=6 and c=7 remainders, and the merged DRAT certificate in PR #6216 are different questions. Remote discussion and open-PR snapshots were not refreshed through `find_overlap.py`; the offline report says so.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only, from the repository root. Author-checked on 2026-11-10 after the scope-text correction:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/c5-mask-centre-nondetermination/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/c5-mask-centre-nondetermination/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-mask-centre-nondetermination --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-mask-centre-nondetermination
```

Marker: `PASS_C5_MASK_CENTRE_NONDETERMINATION assignments=4095 illegal_only=2364 both=1731 legal_only=0 no_zero=1573 zero_but_illegal=791 classes=845+721+7 constructed=5826 midpoint_q16=21 weight2_polarities=2 weight6_forces_legal=0 joint_weight2=13 joint_missing=2 controls=9`

The marker token is the package id. `legal_only=0` and `weight6_forces_legal=0` are Result 1. `weight2_polarities=2` is Result 2. `joint_weight2=13` counts masks on one six-D window example and is not a conjunction-16 result.

The registered package replay passed in both command modes. `scripts/check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` was not run: this checkout is shallow (the preflight requires full history). The metadata pin check passed against the base-commit blobs that are present. No Lean, Docker, or historical suite was run.

Two witness words were first found by a local CaDiCaL search. The replay checks those literal words and does not call a solver.

## Credit

The depth-two interface and the weight identity are Nick Petalas's (PR #4231, PR #4248, PR #6107), with the Ross Richardson PR #934 / PR #943 lineage. JosieElliston's PR #6141 is the solver exclusion. queelius's merged PR #6216 is the characteristic-5 DRAT certificate and is not replayed. The centre-freeze and hypothesis (H) are open PR #7038. The sorted word is the weight-two control of `research/connector-six-source-small-char`.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. For a floor word that realizes all fifteen weight-2 masks and the weight-6 mask together, what is the status of `S(16)`? Result 1 and Result 2 do not apply to that word. This package does not take the next step of treating that conjunction as its own hypothesis. No joint word is constructed or excluded here, and the PR #6216 empty-fibre assertion is not an input to this census.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The one-window census and the weight-2 family are separate checks. They do not decide a word that realizes both. Link once: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
